description: Frontier Desk's published notes, newest first: each one's title, the day it was published, its own address on the site, and its first sentence. Pass a slug from here to get_note for the whole note. The same notes render at https://www.frontierdesk.ai/intel, with an RSS feed at https://www.frontierdesk.ai/intel/rss.xml.

limit.description: How many notes to return, newest first.

since.description: Only notes published on or after this day, as YYYY-MM-DD. For example "2026-10-01".

name: list_notes
title: List the desk's published notes
